chunks: Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim narrated from Ṣāliḥ ibn al-Sindī, from Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān al-Baṣrī, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: "Inform me about the qawwād; what is his prescribed punishment?"
He said: "There is no hadd upon the qawwād. Is it not that he is only given payment for facilitating?"
I said: "May I be your ransom, he is only bringing together a male and a female unlawfully."
He said: "That is the one who brings together a male and a female unlawfully."
So I said: "That is indeed the one, may I be your ransom."
He said: "He is to be struck with three-quarters of the hadd of the fornicator—seventy-five lashes—and he is to be exiled from the town in which he is."

key_terms.الْقَوَّادِ: a procurer or panderer who facilitates unlawful sexual meetings
key_terms.الْمُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَ الذَّكَرِ وَ الْأُنْ: the one who brings a man and a woman together unlawfully
key_terms.حَدِّ الزَّانِي: the prescribed punishment of a fornicator
key_terms.يُنْفَى مِنَ الْمِصْرِ: he is banished from the town

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a procurer who arranges unlawful relations in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith asks about the legal punishment for a procurer who unlawfully brings a man and a woman together. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام clarifies the case under discussion and states that such a person is punished with seventy-five lashes, which is three-quarters of the hadd of zina, and is exiled from his town.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5061 - Ibrahim bin Hashim narrated from Salih bin Al-Sindi from Muhammad bin Sulayman Al-Basri from Abdullah bin Sinan.
He said: I said to Abu Abdullah (as), "Inform me about the qawwad (panderer), what is his prescribed punishment?"
The Imam (as) replied: "There is no hadd (fixed legal punishment) on the qawwad. is he not merely receiving payment for facilitating?"
I said: "May I be your ransom, but he is bringing together a man and a woman unlawfully."
Imam (as) said: "That is the one who arranges unlawful meetings between a man and a woman."
I said: "Yes, that is the case, may I be your ransom."
Imam (as) said: "He is to be lashed three-quarters of the punishment of a fornicator - seventy-five lashes - and he is to be exiled from the city in which he resides."
